name: Unidentified DUM-series pit droid (Balnab)
description: A pit droid was present on the planet of Balnab where he, along with at least three other pit droids had created a giant holographic image of a Balnab named Albee Dewaw where they managed to fool the local Balnabs into thinking that Dewaw was a powerful lord. They then forced the Balnabs into slavery. However, their rule came to an end with the arrival of C-3PO and R2-D2.
